title: linear fetch_sprints
description: One record per Linear cycle, archived ones included, for every team. The payload is the connector's CycleNode re-encoded, so every key is always present and nothing else is.

name.description: Cycle name. Empty string when unnamed, which is common.

startsAt.description: Cycle start. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

endsAt.description: Cycle end. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

completedAt.description: When the cycle completed, or null.

archivedAt.description: When the entity was archived, or null.

updatedAt.description: When the cycle last changed. Also the DataDate. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

progress.description: Completion from 0 to 1, computed by Linear.

team.description: The team the cycle belongs to.

key.description: Team key, such as ENG. Renameable.
